_comment: CUSTOM MCP CHANNEL example: adds a dedicated .mcp_*.log file for all MCP traffic -- also the template for defining your own channel. MCP tools (mcp__<server>__<tool>) already route through the built-in 'mcp' category; this example captures that traffic to its own channel so it can be read in isolation. The channel's options.subtype_split: true splits it per-server into .mcp-github_*.log, .mcp-todoai_*.log, etc. -- set it to false (or remove it) for one combined .mcp_*.log.
